purpose: Classify ventilation-control input requirements by the standard/runtime layer that should own their validation.
principles: Do not duplicate IFC schema validation.
Prefer buildingSMART IDS for machine-readable information-delivery requirements that IDS can express.
Keep AirTrajectory-specific gates for geometry, topology reconstruction, physics readiness, provenance, and control semantics.

requirements.description: At least one modeled IfcSpace is available.
Each control zone has stable IFC identity.
Each control zone has a positive usable volume, delivered or derived with declared fidelity.
Each controlled door/window has positive width and height.
Each opening resolves to exactly one modeled space plus outside, or exactly two modeled spaces.
Spaces/openings have usable geometry for topology/physics projection.
Imported topology binds source format/hash and importer identity/version.
Resolved topology is accepted by the selected physics adapter without invented engineering data.
